db:select.doc:name: Fetch Embedding for Service Call
db:select.db:sql: SELECT search_embedding::text AS embedding_text FROM service_calls_test WHERE service_call_id = :serviceCallId

db:select.doc:name: Find Top-K Similar Calls
db:select.db:sql: SELECT service_call_id FROM service_calls_test WHERE service_call_id != :serviceCallId AND search_embedding IS NOT NULL ORDER BY search_embedding <=> :embedding ::vector LIMIT :topK

db:select.doc:name: Get Material Frequencies
db:select.db:sql: SELECT m.material_id::text AS material_id, m.itemnmbr, m.itemdesc, m.item_category AS category, m.usage_count AS catalog_usage, COUNT(*) AS usage_freq FROM hvac_service_items_test i JOIN hvac_materials m ON i.material_id = m.material_id WHERE i.service_call_id = ANY(ARRAY[ :ids ]::text[]) GROUP BY m.material_id, m.itemnmbr, m.itemdesc, m.item_category, m.usage_count ORDER BY usage_freq DESC

set-variable.doc:name: No Similar Calls – Empty Freq Results

db:select.doc:name: Keyword Search in hvac_materials
db:select.db:sql: SELECT material_id::text AS material_id, itemnmbr, itemdesc, item_category AS category, usage_count AS catalog_usage FROM hvac_materials WHERE itemdesc ILIKE ANY(ARRAY[ :patterns ]::text[]) OR item_category ILIKE ANY(ARRAY[ :patterns ]::text[]) LIMIT 200

db:select.doc:name: Get Existing Material IDs for Call
db:select.db:sql: SELECT material_id::text AS material_id FROM hvac_service_items_test WHERE service_call_id = :serviceCallId

db:select.doc:name: Get Max Catalog Usage Count
db:select.db:sql: SELECT MAX(usage_count) AS max_usage FROM hvac_materials
